name: Sturdy
description: Once this Pokemon senses weakness, it begins acting according to their brutal nature. They can be cruel if not put in their place.
effect: The first time this Pokemon would faint due to a Damaging move, it will remain at 1 HP instead. Status Ailments and Self-inflicted damage will still cause it to faint. The Pokemon must rest for an hour before benefiting from Sturdy again.
